comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 3a9441f. onExpanderChange takes the left neighbour and keeps it only if its model is modelTapeRecorder. The Time knob runs 0.4 to 1 and is raised to the power of 16 in TapeAudioDisplay::drawText; Amplitude runs 0.5 to 1.5 and is the exponent of half the display width. The module has no inputs or outputs at all.
